params.body: Rewords the 503 maintenance page so it reads as ordinary maintenance instead of a server move that reassures visitors about their data: the heading becomes "Stocklist Dealer is even in onderhoud", the body drops the "Je gegevens zijn veilig; je hoeft niets te doen" line entirely and states only "Zodra het onderhoud klaar is, verschijnt Stocklist Dealer hier weer vanzelf", the page title and footer label switch from "verhuis"/"server" to "onderhoud", `MaintenanceModeTest` asserts on the new copy and that the page never contains "veilig", "verhuist", "server" or "hoeft niets", and rule R P3-12.1 in the business-rules doc is updated to match.
params.title: The maintenance page stops saying the data is safe
